title: The Atlas of Unmade Land
subtitle: A Novel of Maps, Bridges and Honest Numbers
blurb: In the kingdom of Aster, a map drawn from honest, double-checked measurement can hold the land it describes in place. Sixteen-year-old Isla Corrin, a ferry-chain maker's daughter and the Meridian Guild's only scholarship apprentice, is handed the impossible commission of charting the Unmade, a drifting stretch of loose country, in forty days. With a lamed master, a barge-born chain-bearer, a bridge-builder's apprentice and a rival who trusts estimates, she crosses the haze with a chain, a sightglass and a stubborn habit of checking everything three times. Then she finds a village the Atlas erased forty-four years ago, and the family name that was blamed for it.
author: Yang
